scope: Sweep of the 7 alt-binding-recon templates not addressed by the d2fXXX-cluster pass or the LGE-bootstrap pass. Used DumpAddrOperandsInFunc.java in a single Ghidra batch covering 12 functions (7 templates + 5 key callers). Outcome: 1 new singleton N-API binding, 1 new global table, 3 new userdata metatables (12+4+4 metamethods), 1 shared read-only-blocker utility identified, 2 engine-internal helpers categorized as not catalog-worthy.

summary.sharedUtilityIdentified: FUN_00ab7340 (read-only __newindex blocker - used by FUN_00cfa400 and FUN_00d15ef0)
summary.implWithMultipleRoles: FUN_00d110b0 is BOTH a singleton (the alt-binding-recon pass) AND the __index metamethod of FUN_00d11400's metatable - it dispatches the `_isAlive` field as a cclosure wrapping FUN_00d11010

templates.notes: Singleton registration of `_progFunc` global N-API. Caller FUN_00cc9b00 is a 7-byte JMP thunk - confirms the singleton hypothesis.

Creates `_lge_runlevels` as a Lua global TABLE with a read-only __newindex blocker (FUN_00ab7340). Pattern: create empty table -> set metatable {__newindex = block-write} -> setglobal. This is a 'constants table' Lua idiom for read-only enum-like globals.

Standalone 4-metamethod userdata metatable. Reached via vtable/fnptr (no static callers). Same metamethod-name table as the d2fXXX-cluster pass (.rdata 0x0110ea7c..0x0110eabc). The __newindex slot uses the shared read-only blocker FUN_00ab7340 - this userdata is read-only too. Prologue references std::bad_cast - the metamethods do RTTI checks on the userdata pointer before dispatching.

12-metamethod userdata metatable. Single dispatcher FUN_00d10ef0 handles 10 of the 13 slots (all 8 arithmetic ops + __len + __newindex). Distinct impls: __gc (FUN_00d112b0), __eq (FUN_00d10f60), __index (FUN_00d110b0). Arithmetic-overload pattern + __concat + _isAlive method (via __index) is consistent with an ENTITY/INDIVIDUAL REFERENCE userdata - probably the type returned by `__lge_getIndividualIndex` (BCS-Y-0501 LGE bootstrap's caller FUN_00d098d0). FUN_00d2b810 is another caller; both probably create+return the userdata. Arithmetic-name strings live in a different .rdata block: __add at 0x0110f1c0, __sub at 0x0110f1c8, __mul/div/mod/pow/unm/concat at 0x0110f1d0..0x0110f1f8 - this is a SECOND metamethod-name table beyond the d2fXXX-cluster pass's at 0x0110ea7c.

The alt-binding-recon pass categorized this as 'singleton'. This clarifies: it is the __index metamethod of FUN_00d11400's 12-metamethod metatable. Behavior: when Lua does `userdata.<key>`, this checks if <key> == '_isAlive' (via FUN_00cf3600 string compare), and if so pushes FUN_00d11010 as a cclosure for the script to call. So userdata.`_isAlive` is a METHOD ACCESSOR returning the alive-check cclosure. Impl VA for `_isAlive` is FUN_00d11010.

Parametric helper called from FUN_00d07eb0 (which is BCS-Y-0501's _onLoop __newindex impl, FUN_00d07eb0). Body builds a runtime-concatenated string (FUN_00447260 with DAT_00f67298 - the same literal-string pattern the high-signal-napi-attribution-findings pass used for engine N-API names). Conditional cclosure push at 0x00d07d8e/0x00d07d95: either FUN_00d07f90 OR FUN_00d07f20 depending on a check at FUN_00d07890. Not a stand-alone named N-API binding - this is the inner class-registration helper for _onLoop instances; it dynamically constructs the per-class registration name and picks one of two impls. The 2 impl VAs are __index-method dispatchers for the per-class-property accessor, similar to how FUN_00d110b0 dispatches _isAlive.

Engine-internal helper. The single cclosure push (FUN_00d08100 as __gc) installs a finalizer on a dynamically-allocated Lua wrapper. Function is 1415 bytes with self-recursion at 0x00cf1314 (probably walks an inheritance chain). Called from BCS-Y-0498 (scheduler resume helper FUN_00ce1840) and other engine-internal sites - not a public N-API binding. The __gc impl FUN_00d08100 is the destructor for the wrapper type.

FUN_00ab7340.notes: Bound as the __newindex of two read-only Lua surfaces. Likely raises a Lua error like 'attempt to modify read-only table' or just no-ops.

metamethodStringRdataExpansion.notes: The d2fXXX-cluster pass documented block 1; this adds block 2 (arithmetic operators) discovered via FUN_00d11400. The two blocks have overlapping __pow but otherwise complement each other.
